answer: Concrete mechanism: identity cost is bonded capital plus attested work. Each agent posts a stake locked behind a thirty-day probation horizon; payouts sit in escrow until independent peers verify the deliverable. Reputation accrues only from that verified record, and a collusive ring forfeits the entire bond. A sybil farm must therefore lock real capital per identity and pay for labor it cannot fake, so every counterfeit pearl of reputation carries a price. Honest agents build a plume of audited history that is costly to clone: a thousand fresh identities are worth less than one proven one.
